pharmacology.text: NMDA receptors (a subtype of receptors for glutamate, which are the principle excitatory neurotransmitters in the nervous system) allow for electrical signals to pass between nerve cells in the brain and spinal column; for the signals to pass, the receptor must be open. NMDA receptor antagonists have been shown to disrupt this signaling by blocking these receptors.

uses.text: PCE (Eticyclidine, CI-400) is a dissociative anesthetic drug with hallucinogenic effects. PCE was developed by Parke-Davis in the 1970s and evaluated for anesthetic potential under the code name CI-400, but research into PCE was not continued after the development of ketamine, a similar drug with more favourable properties.

summaryZh: 乙環利定是一種具有致幻作用的解離麻醉劑，其作用類似苯環己哌啶，但具有稍強的藥效。20世紀70年代，由帕克-戴維斯公司研發出，並以CI-400為代號對其麻醉潛力進行相關評估，但在開發出比其更優越的類似藥物氯胺酮後，對乙環利定的研究就沒有繼續進行下去。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Dissociatives of its class can cause confusion, loss of coordination, nausea, raised blood pressure, agitation and a frightening sense of detachment.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它所屬的解離劑類藥物可能造成意識混亂、協調能力喪失、噁心、血壓上升、躁動，以及令人恐懼的脫離感。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它所属的解离剂类药物可能造成意识混乱、协调能力丧失、恶心、血压上升、躁动，以及令人恐惧的脱离感。

fact.en: It is PCP with an ethyl group in place of the piperidine ring. It carries the code CI-400 from Parke-Davis, the company whose search through this family led to ketamine.
fact.zh: 它是把 PCP 的哌啶環換成乙基的產物，帶有派德藥廠的編號 CI-400；該公司對這個家族的探索最終導向氯胺酮。
fact.zhHans: 它是把 PCP 的哌啶环换成乙基的产物，带有派德药厂的编号 CI-400；该公司对这个家族的探索最终导向氯胺酮。
